note: Every effect flipbook (roadmap 18.3, checklist C1): the point of the picture that must stay still while the frames play (the anchor), and where that point sits in the frame (originX, originY: the same numbers the game's code uses for the sprite's origin). dev/tools/align_fx.py puts all frames of a family on one same-size canvas with the anchor on that point; dev/tests/fxdrift.cjs fails if an anchor moves more than 3 percent of the frame's width. Anchor kinds: base = the foot of the effect (the lowest solid row, and the middle of the weight just above it), for things that rise from the ground; boxbase = the bottom middle of everything drawn, for rings lying round the feet; box = the middle of everything drawn, for symbols and rings seen flat; mass = the middle of the weight, for clouds; core = the middle of the brightest tenth of the pixels, for an orb or a burning symbol whose flames flicker round it; tip = the point of a thrown spear (drawn flying right); keep = leave the frames alone (already one canvas from one camera, or steady), still checked by its named anchor if 'check' is set.
